title: Poised for breakout moment in Latin America, Pope Leo faces test of health
summary_full: Just weeks after cancer surgery, Pope Leo XIV, who has arrived in Montevideo, Uruguay, will navigate the region’s tide of secularism, deep polarization — and high altitudes.
